jobs.description:
As a Mechanical Assembly Technician, you will work on the assembly of high-quality machines and technical systems used within the high-tech industry. From the first components to a fully operational machine, you play an important role throughout the entire build process. Together with colleagues from different technical disciplines, you ensure that every machine is assembled accurately, tested thoroughly and prepared for delivery. No project is the same: one day you may be assembling complex modules in the workshop, while the next day you may support installation or commissioning activities at a customer location. Your responsibilities include: Assembling machines, modules and technical installations. Installing and connecting mechanical and electrical components. Testing machines and checking functionality and quality. Reading and applying technical drawings and work instructions. Identifying and resolving technical issues during assembly. Contributing ideas to improve assembly processes. Working closely with colleagues to successfully complete projects. Arbeidsvoorwaarden You will join an innovative organization where technology, craftsmanship and personal development are key. You will work on challenging projects within high-tech machine building and have the opportunity to continuously expand your technical skills. We offer: A competitive salary based on your knowledge and experience. 25 vacation days and additional ADV days. A solid pension scheme. Travel allowance. Training opportunities and possibilities for professional growth. Working with modern tools and the latest technologies. A collaborative working environment with skilled and enthusiastic colleagues. The opportunity for a permanent contract after a successful probation period. Functie-eisen You are a technically skilled professional who enjoys building advanced machines and solving technical challenges. You work accurately, take responsibility for your work and enjoy collaborating with others to

deliver high-quality solutions. You have: A technical MBO-level education, preferably in Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a similar field. Experience as a Mechanical Assembly Technician, Machine Builder or in a similar technical role. Experience reading technical drawings. Strong mechanical skills; electrical knowledge is an advantage. A structured and quality-focused approach to your work. Good command of the Dutch and/or English language. A proactive attitude and a team-oriented mindset. Hier kom je te werken Through us, you will join an innovative organization active in high-tech machine building. The company develops, builds and delivers advanced machines and technical systems for leading companies within the technology industry. You will work in a modern environment where craftsmanship, innovation and collaboration come together. There is plenty of room for personal development, and you will have the opportunity to contribute to projects where you can see the direct impact of your work.

Get an awesome salary of €16,78 and enjoy working dayshifts only! All while working with the best smelling flowers. Read on and watch your new job as an orderpicker blossom, literally. 🌸 Apply today at Royal FloraHolland in Honselersdijk! 🥳

Who you are
To make sure everything runs smoothly, it's important that as an orderpicker, you'll meet the following requirements:

Early in the morning, you’ll be working with carts full of beautiful flowers. You check if everything is correct: Are the flowers fresh and in good condition? Does the cart match the order?
Once everything is perfect, you roll the cart to the right spot. Then, a small electric vehicle (kind of like a mini lawn mower!) picks it up and brings it straight to the truck. Thanks to your work, the flowers arrive on time and in top shape at their destination! 🙌

Where will you work
You’ll be working at the world’s largest flower auction site! Yes, really! That’s how massive the warehouse in Honselersdijk (near Naaldwijk) is. As an orderpicker, you will find  your way around in no time though. Within weeks  you’ll be driving like a pro

 This is what you need to know if you are a truck driver… or want to become one 
Of course: you spend a lot of time on the road and transport (often) goods from A to B. But behind that steering wheel lies a profession where responsibility, independence, and craftsmanship come together. Whether you are just starting or have been driving for years: this is what you need to know as a truck driver. You are the business card on wheels 
As a driver, you represent not only yourself, but also your employer and the client. You are present on customer sites, at loading and unloading locations, and sometimes even at private addresses. A professional attitude, clear communication, and keeping agreements are therefore just as important as good driving skills. Safety always comes first 
Safe working as a professional driver is not a side issue. You deal with heavy vehicles, changing weather conditions, and busy traffic. Knowing and respecting driving and rest time regulations is essential, as is correctly securing cargo. Even small things, such as getting in and out safely, staying alert when reversing, and paying attention to blind spots, make a big difference. If you want to refresh this knowledge, you can consider the training 'Updating professional competence for drivers'. This also falls under the Code 95 regulation. 
In addition, it is important not only to drive safely, but also to know how to act when something goes wrong. Training such as first aid (EHBO), emergency response (BHV), and VCA provides practical knowledge about working safely, recognizing risks, and acting correctly in case of incidents.  July 02, 2026 
We have launched our EUDR Readiness Solution to help organizations move from data collection to credible compliance. Most EU Deforestation Regulation (EUDR) implementation failures are not caused by a single missing field. They stem from weak connections between evidence types, across scope coverage, origin evidence, traceability controls, legal confirmation, geospatial credibility and risk governance. A risk-based readiness framework 
Our readiness solution is a modular, risk-based consulting and verification framework that combines gap assessment, targeted technical review, training and independent verification, covering over 220 control points across the entire EUDR chain. We assess whether your EUDR due diligence system, first-mile/farm/forest evidence, geolocation data, legality evidence and supply chain controls are credible to support the relevant EUDR decisions and responsibilities, as well as a defensible due diligence decision. Why software alone is not enough 
Software platforms are powerful, but they do not automatically validate the accuracy, relevance or sufficiency of evidence. Tools can collect supplier declarations, store farm lists and geolocation files, run automated risk screening, generate dashboards and due diligence workflows, and centralize documentation. Readiness support adds the verification layer that makes evidence defensible: - Assess whether origin evidence is credible - Evaluate whether the data corresponds to the declared production reality - Review the assumptions, data sources and conclusions behind the results - Test whether governance, responsibilities and escalation controls operate effectively - Test volume, product-flow and traceability controls - Assess whether decisions are documented, justified and consistently applied
